title: Hana Korean Academy — bilingual school website
client_fictional: Hana Korean Academy (fictional Korean language & culture school in Toronto)
summary_en: A playful, K-culture-modern one-page site for a fictional Korean school in Toronto, with an English / 한국어 toggle, animated Hangul hero, a flip-card “learn one word” game, course cards in CAD, a filterable timetable and a demo trial-booking form. Concept project — all names, addresses and contacts are placeholders.
